members.name: value
members.description: Root accepts scalar or array value/defaultValue, min0/max100, step1, largeStep10, orientation horizontal|vertical, disabled/name/form, minStepsBetweenValues and thumbCollisionBehavior push|swap|none. Wrapper thumbAlignment defaults edge but {...props} can override it. onValueChange has cancellable ChangeEventDetails with reason and activeThumbIndex; onValueCommitted has generic CommitEventDetails and only reports a changed, uncanceled commit. Source quantizes/clamps pointer/keyboard changes and enforces range collision policy. IMPORTANT wrapper quirk: thumb count is array value length, else array defaultValue length, else2; scalar props still create two Thumb instances. This reference explicitly uses value={[40]} for one thumb and arrays for ranges. Wrapper does not expose per-thumb naming/index props; Root aria-labelledby is propagated through primitive context to its internal range inputs.

events.name: onValueChange

type.text: (value: number | readonly number[], eventDetails: SliderPrimitive.Root.ChangeEventDetails) => void

events.description: Actual cancellable source React callback, preserving eventDetails and native event. Controlled props remain authoritative.

events.name: onValueCommitted

type.text: (value: number | readonly number[], eventDetails: SliderPrimitive.Root.CommitEventDetails) => void

events.description: Actual generic commit callback after changed, uncanceled interaction; not another cancellable value request.
